title: Needs-to-goals trace (IEP draft)
summary: Checks a draft IEP before the team meets: every need from the evaluation and present levels maps to a measurable annual goal or a stated reason for none, and every goal has a documented need, a baseline on the same measure, a progress method and reporting schedule, and a service with start date, frequency, location and duration. The case manager approves the draft for the meeting; the team, including the parent, adopts or changes it there.

values.label: Draft ready for the IEP team meeting

notAssessed: Eligibility, placement and the final goals and services: the IEP team, including the parent, decides them at the meeting.
Whether a goal is ambitious enough for the student: a team judgment the trace cannot make.
notes: Label every output as a draft. A plan that looks finished before the meeting undercuts the parent's part in the decision.

Benchmarks or short-term objectives are required for students who take alternate assessments (34 CFR 300.320(a)(2)(ii)); transition goals by the IEP in effect at age 16, earlier in some states (300.320(b)).
The same trace (need, goal, measure, service) carries over to 504 plans, IFSPs and treatment plans with a different requirement set.
Student records are protected (FERPA): web lookups for this type use only public regulations and guidance, and carry no student details.

inputs.label: A current evaluation with identified needs
inputs.help: Link the most recent evaluation report (or reevaluation) that identifies the student's needs.

inputs.label: Present levels of performance
inputs.help: Draft the present levels from current data before checking goals.

config.instructions: List each need the evaluation identifies and each need stated in the present levels, with the data behind it. Merge duplicates; keep the evaluation's wording where possible. When the draft states why a need has no annual goal (met through accommodations, services or another goal), give that reason; otherwise leave it empty.

fields.name: area
fields.label: Area
fields.description: Reading, writing, math, communication, behavior, motor, daily living and so on

fields.name: data
fields.label: Present-level data
fields.description: The current measure and result behind the need

fields.name: source
fields.label: Source
fields.description: Evaluation, progress report, assessment, teacher or parent input

fields.name: reason_no_goal
fields.label: Reason for no goal
fields.description: The reason the draft states for addressing this need without an annual goal; empty when it states none

config.instructions: List each proposed annual goal with its parts, its baseline, how progress is measured and reported, and the service that supports it, as the draft states them. Leave a field empty when the draft does not state it.

fields.name: behavior
fields.label: Behavior
fields.description: The behavior the student will show

fields.name: criterion
fields.label: Criterion
fields.description: How well, how often, on what measure

fields.name: target_date
fields.label: Target date
fields.description: The date the goal is to be met by

fields.name: baseline
fields.label: Baseline
fields.description: Current performance on the goal's measure

fields.name: report_schedule
fields.label: Reported to parent
fields.description: When progress reports go to the parent

fields.name: service
fields.label: Service
fields.description: The service or support behind the goal, with start date, frequency, location and duration if stated

config.question: Does each goal address a documented need from the evaluation or present levels? Link the need(s) it addresses. Needs no goal links to are flagged unless the draft states a reason for no goal.

config.instructions: Check each goal in <items> as written.

checklist.label: Observable behavior
checklist.question: Does the goal name a behavior someone could see or count (not understand, improve, appreciate)?

checklist.label: Condition, criterion and date
checklist.question: Does the goal state a condition, a criterion and a target date within one year?

checklist.label: Baseline on the same measure
checklist.question: Is there a baseline, on the same measure and unit as the criterion?

checklist.label: Target above baseline
checklist.question: Is the target beyond the baseline (not at or below it)?

checklist.label: Not carried over unchanged
checklist.question: Does the goal appear to be carried over unchanged from an earlier IEP without new data? Mark not_met if so.

checklist.label: One skill per goal
checklist.question: Does the goal measure one skill rather than several bundled together?

checklist.label: Progress measure stated
checklist.question: Does the draft say how progress toward this goal will be measured, using the goal's own measure?

checklist.label: Reporting schedule stated
checklist.question: Does the draft say when progress on this goal is reported to the parent?

checklist.label: A service behind the goal
checklist.question: Is there a service or support in the draft that serves this goal?

checklist.label: Start date, frequency, location, duration
checklist.question: Does that service state its projected start date, frequency, location and duration (placeholders count as stated)?

checklist.label: Special factors considered
checklist.question: Does the draft address each special factor (behavior, limited English proficiency, Braille, communication, assistive technology), even if only to say it is not indicated (34 CFR 300.324(a)(2))?

checklist.label: Objectives for alternate assessment
checklist.question: If the student takes an alternate assessment on alternate standards, do the goals include benchmarks or short-term objectives? Mark not_applicable otherwise.

checklist.label: Transition planning when due
checklist.question: If the IEP will be in effect when the student turns 16 (or earlier where the state requires), does it include measurable postsecondary goals and transition services? Mark not_applicable otherwise.

checklist.label: Participation with peers explained
checklist.question: Does the draft explain the extent, if any, to which the student would not take part with nondisabled peers?

checklist.label: Worded as a draft
checklist.question: Is the document labelled a draft, with goals, services and placement worded as proposals for the team rather than decisions?

config.instructions: Review the trace and every gap, then approve the draft for the meeting or send it back. Approval means the draft is ready to bring to the IEP team; the team, including the parent, adopts or changes the goals and services there.
